_comment: Canned grid sequence for eval/score_skill_rung1.py --dry: a push-block macro on a tiny grid. Each entry is one post-action frame (RESET first, then 4 ACTION1 presses). The block (color 2) is at (2,3) on RESET; it moves one cell left each push until it lands in the container cell (0,3), which flips from color 3 to color 4 on delivery -- the moment a human reading this would call the macro 'done'. The macro under test is repeat_until(steps=[ACTION1], stop_when=grid_changed_in_region(0,3,0,3), max_iters=8).
